import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] b = new long[20];

    static long dfs(long x, long sum) {
        long num = x / b[(int) sum];
        x = x % b[(int) sum];
        if (x == 0)
            return num * sum;
        else
            return num * sum + Math.min(dfs(x, sum - 1), sum + dfs(b[(int) sum] - x, sum - 1));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        for (int i = 1; i <= 17; i++) {
            b[i] = b[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        int m = 0;
        long x = n;
        while (x != 0) {
            x /= 10;
            m++;
        }
        System.out.println(dfs(n, m + 2));
        sc.close();
    }
}
